title: Cloud Security: excluded incidents
content:
Cloud Security uses the following tier-specific bases for excluded incidents.

## Basis

Excluded incident causes: Incident cause codes excluded from service credits; string list.

## Tier values

| Security tier | Excluded incident causes |
|---|---|
| Northbridge Cloud Security 50 Workloads | customer change, scheduled maintenance, upstream customer |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 100 Workloads | customer change, scheduled maintenance, upstream customer |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 250 Workloads | customer change, scheduled maintenance, upstream customer |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 500 Workloads | customer change, scheduled maintenance, upstream customer |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 1000 Workloads | customer change, scheduled maintenance, upstream customer |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 2500 Workloads | customer change, scheduled maintenance, upstream customer |

## Tier comparison

The listed excluded incidents bases are the same across these six Security tiers.
